support.notes: Windows settings can select DJI Mic 2 and report a real recording endpoint; continuous recording and transmitter-control mapping are not accepted on real hardware.

transports.notes: DJI officially documents connecting the receiver to a computer by USB-C; endpoint behavior is verified from Windows audio enumeration.
Windows HFP recording availability depends on device state and is verified by the audio-input endpoint.

protocols.notes: No undocumented Bluetooth or control protocol is claimed or implemented.

platforms.notes: Windows Bluetooth HFP identity and recording endpoints are confirmed on real hardware; continuous recording and physical-control acceptance remain pending.
